psychological_meaning: Metallic Copper embodies a sense of grounded luxury and warmth. It evokes feelings of stability, comfort, and sophistication, blending the earthiness of brown with the opulence of metallic finishes. This color suggests a balance between tradition and modernity, promoting a feeling of secure elegance and understated richness.
